faqs.question: How quickly can IntelliGreen systems be installed?
faqs.answer: Our wall-mounted CTFA units and plug-and-play IAQ smart sensors can be deployed within 24 to 48 hours without major HVAC structural overhaul.

faqs.question: Are IntelliGreen products certified for healthcare and hospital usage?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our HEPA filtration and UV-C / Bipolar Ionisation units comply with ISO Cleanroom and hospital air safety specifications.

faqs.question: Can I monitor indoor air quality remotely on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes, our IntelliGreen AI Cloud platform provides a responsive web dashboard and real-time mobile app alerts for facility managers.

faqs.question: How do I request a site audit for my facility?
faqs.answer: Simply fill out our contact form below or call our support team at +91-124 425 6862 / +91-99710 02858 to schedule a free on-site air quality audit.
